programme.desc: Renée Zellwegger returns to play Bridget Jones, the 30-year-old spinster, worried about cellulite, extra pounds and men. After finding love, Bridget Jones wonders if she really has everything she ever dreamed of having.

programme.title: On the Edge of 18
programme.desc: Growing up isn't easy for some, like for Nadine, a student who has to deal with the fact that her best friend is dating her older brother. Nadine feels more alone than ever, until she meets a young man who gives her all his attention.

programme.title: Mona Lisa's Smile
programme.desc: In 1953, an Art History teacher at a girls' school tries to broaden the narrow horizons of her brilliant students. The biggest challenge will be to make students find (and assume) their cultural identity, starting from a broad and challenging vision of new knowledge.

programme.title: Nikki and Nora: The Detective Twins
programme.desc: Fraternal twins Nikki and Nora are forced back into each other's lives when they inherit a detective agency. As they work together to solve a homicide, they quickly realize that their differences may be their greatest advantage.

programme.title: Steel Flowers
programme.desc: Truvy's beauty salon is a meeting place for a unique group of friends: M'Lynn, the overprotective mother, Shelby, her daughter, Annelle, the "glamor" technician, Ouiser, the bitter old woman, and Clairee, the recent widow who will finally be happy.

programme.title: Murder in...
programme.desc: MURDER IN VERDON. In the Verdon Gorges, retired Major Thierry Rouvier and young captain Elie Zakine come together to investigate the murder of a 78-year-old man found in the Castillon dam.

programme.title: Murder in...
programme.desc: MURDER IN GREEN PERIGORD. Tourtoirac, summer 2022. A series of murders disturbs the tranquility of this small village in Périgord Vert. The same modus operandi is repeated: the victims are decapitated.

programme.title: Outlander
programme.desc: Jamie struggles with his first order as an Indian agent; Roger presides over an unusual funeral. Marsali gives birth.

programme.title: Outlander
programme.desc: Fergus worries about his new son's quality of life when the baby is bullied by superstitious Protestants. Claire performs surgery on Tom's hand.

programme.title: Sandokan: The Pirate Prince
programme.desc: Marianne celebrates her 21st birthday. Both Sandokan and Brooke are invited to the dance. There is some tension between the three, but Sandokan must first free Yanez and his crew.

programme.title: Sandokan: The Pirate Prince
programme.desc: As Sandokan heads to the Sultan's antimony mines to plunder them, Brooke pursues him relentlessly, with the help of Sergeant Murray.

programme.title: Quarto 309
programme.desc: As Lale's henna night approaches, Lale and Onur continue preparations at home and are very excited about the idea of ​​having a baby. Onur doesn't forget the bet he won. Samet is anxiously waiting for Nergis.

programme.title: Quarto 309
programme.desc: As Lale and the family prepare for the henna night, Pelinsu cannot accept what is happening, and her mother begins to suspect that she is in love with Onur. As Onur and Lale imagine their baby's future, Yildiz is nervous.

programme.title: Quarto 309
programme.desc: While Yildiz is unable to accept Lale and his family, Onur's affection for his fiancée's family visibly grows. The situation becomes more complicated for Samet when Lale moves into Onur's house. Betül and Filiz have been furnishing the house.

programme.title: Fallen Angels Club: Heroes and Villains
programme.desc: Members of the Fallen Angels Murder Club search for answers about the mysterious death of one of their own. Hollis finds himself at the center of the investigation when a journalist covering the case also turns up dead.

programme.title: How to Kill Your Husband
programme.desc: Nancy Crampton-Brophy, known for writing about homicides and tumultuous relationships, fantasies about killing or running away from her husband, and even faking her own death, was arrested in 2022 for murdering her husband.

programme.title: Deadly Secrets
programme.desc: A young military wife's illicit affair ends in tragedy when suspicions arise about her unexpected disappearance in the mines of Joshua Tree National Park.

programme.title: The Curious Cook: Dying for Chocolate
programme.desc: Goldy Berry is a catering entrepreneur from Colorado who unexpectedly finds herself in the role of investigator as she tries to uncover the mysterious death of a friend. With time running out, he forms an unlikely partnership with a detective to find the killer.

programme.title: A Spark of Christmas
programme.desc: Molly has recently become a widow and, with some reluctance, accepts the task of directing a Christmas show. Soon, she begins to fall in love with Hank, the play's protagonist and the city's most eligible bachelor.

programme.title: Everything We Had
programme.desc: A single mother, on the brink of poverty, moves to a new city in order to start over and try to provide her teenage daughter with a better life. A file directed by actress Katie Holmes.

programme.title: 4 Women in Love
programme.desc: Four women live in Phoenix and are inseparable. Among other links, the fact that they all live in disappointing romantic relationships unites them.

programme.title: Poisoned Love: The Stacey Castor Story
programme.desc: Stacey Ruth Castor has overcome the death of her first husband and managed to find love again with her boss, David. But when David is found dead in an apparent suicide, the police suspect foul play.

programme.title: The jewel of the Nile
programme.desc: Jack and Joan are about to get married on a boat on the high seas. But suddenly a horde of pirates attack them and set fire to the facilities. Joan and Jack fight off the tenacious pirates when they realize there is only one place left on the lifeboat. Joan asks Jack to take care of it since she is going to die soon of tuberculosis and it is not worth the man dying. When he leaves she wonders what the buccaneers will do and what her future will be... But this incredible adventure was only part of Joan Wilder's fantasy with which she intends to start writing her new book, in which she is stuck. She has been married to Jack Colton for some time and after the incredible adventures they have had, they find themselves stuck in a port in the south of France bound for Greece, although she would prefer to go to New York. That same afternoon, at a book signing, Joan meets Omar, a benevolent ruler of an Eastern country called Kadir. He invites her to his palace so she can feel like a queen while he writes, but Jack is not amused by this proposal. Quarreled, they decide to separate and take some time while she finishes her book. Suddenly, Joan witnesses how a man named Tarak tries to murder Omar in front of her. For his part, Jack meets a man named Ralph at the port who seeks revenge for his time spent in prison. They both see how a man approaches: it is Tarak, the murderer, who comes to ask them for help. He confesses to them that Omar is actually a horrible dictator who has stolen their most precious treasure, "The Jewel of the Nile." Jack decides to help him when he sees his ship explode and understands that the sheikh intended to kill him and thus, in the process, rescues his wife. But the sheik has great power and it will be very difficult for Jack and Ralph to get their way. The actors who play the tribesmen: Arak, Barak, Karak, Sarak and Tarak, the same ones from the troop of jugglers in The Brothers Karamazov.

programme.title: A crime has been cooked: A Peach Flavored Mystery
programme.desc: A rival bakery and a murder shake Lake Eden. Hannah Swensen investigates who had motives to take down the Quinns and uncover a crime behind sweet appearances.

programme.title: A crime has been cooked: A Deadly Recipe
programme.desc: A sheriff turns up dead with a cupcake in his hand and Hannah's brother-in-law is the main suspect. To save him, the baker sets out to solve a crime full of secrets in Lake Eden.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Alan Parrish is a boy who accidentally finds a board game called Jumanji and convinces his friend Sarah to try it, but very strange events begin to occur and the game will catch them and change their lives. By throwing the dice, Alan is transported to a parallel world, where he will not be able to leave until the game ends, but circumstances cause Sarah to leave and Alan is trapped for 26 years in that other world until two new children find the game and start playing.

programme.title: The Pelican Report
programme.desc: Two judges of the Superior Court of Justice have been murdered. Now, a university professor who knows both victims will find himself involved in the case in a terrible way. One of his students, with whom he is having a relationship, makes a short report of who might want the men dead and gives it to her teacher. He, amazed by the intuition of Darby Shawn, the student, will give the brief report to one of his friends who works for the FBI. What was not expected is that when they began to analyze it, they were completely fascinated to discover its content. But one of the president's men fears that this report will end up tarnishing his image, so he forces the director to get rid of the papers. Meanwhile, drunk, the professor and Darby argue and when she refuses to give him the keys to her car, it suddenly explodes into a thousand pieces. Terrified, she runs home but sees that they have turned everything upside down and some attackers have taken her computer and hard drives. Darby finds himself in the middle of a huge problem that he couldn't even foresee and although he asks a friend from the FBI for help, he turns up dead just before they meet. The report she has written seems to have enraged a very powerful group of men who will now not hesitate for a second to kill everyone who read it and especially the one who wrote it. The rights to "The Pelican Brief" were sold before the book was even written. John Grisham had only a small outline of what the plot would be like when the production company bought the rights. In fact, writer John Grisham wrote the Darby Shaw parts with Julia Roberts in mind. Julia read the book when it was published and accepted the role without even glancing at the script.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Manhattan, New York. After almost thirty years without hearing from them, the ghosts and demons have once again escaped from the underworld to destroy the city. This time a new team of Ghostbusters, made up of a group of four women, is ready to put an end to any spectral threat.

programme.title: hidden figures
programme.desc: As a child, African-American Katherine proved to be a mathematical prodigy. Now, as an adult, she works for NASA... but in the USA of 1961, as a woman and black, her brilliant work means very little.

programme.title: Asterix and Obelix against Caesar
programme.desc: The small village of Asterix and Obelix is ​​the last place that is not under the control of Rome. When the tax collector doesn't get money from its inhabitants, Julius Caesar goes to see what's so special about them.

programme.title: Asterix and Obelix: Mission Cleopatra
programme.desc: The action takes place in the year LII BC. Although not all of Gaul is yet occupied, Egypt, ruled by the powerful Cleopatra, has fallen under the yoke of the Roman Empire. Fed up with Caesar's sarcasm, the proud and beautiful queen makes a bet with him: if he manages to build a palace in the space of three months, he will recognize that the Egyptian people are the greatest of all. Cleopatra entrusts such an impossible mission to Numerobis, an emerging avant-garde architect who undertakes a journey to Gaul to ask for help from Asterix and Obelix.

programme.title: Duplicity
programme.desc: MI6 agent Ray Koval (Clive Owen) is in Dubai when he meets Claire Stenwick (Julia Roberts). After groping her a little, he manages to win her over and they spend the night together, without knowing that Claire is part of the CIA. When Ray wakes up the next day, the woman has disappeared with several compromised documents. For years, Ray searches for her, leaves his job at MI6 and gets a new one in the espionage department of a large multinational. In his third week of work he meets Claire again. Now they both work as spies for large companies and Claire is not willing to allow anyone to come and destroy the professional future she has been building for just over a year. The two spies will use all kinds of tricks to keep their positions, but they will also have to fight against the great attraction they feel for each other so as not to succumb to the other person's deceptions. In this film, actor Clive Owen plays MI6 spy Ray Koval. Owen began his career in television, working mainly on not very well-known series. Currently, although he still makes some stellar appearances on television, he is one of the best-known faces on the big screen. He has worked in films such as 'The Bourne Affair', 'King Arthur' and 'Closer' where he shares the bill for the first time with actress Julia Roberts. In 'Duplicity', Roberts plays Claire Stenwick, a retired CIA agent. The acclaimed actress began her career in 1987, in the series 'The History of Crime'. After that she worked in several films until she gained fame through 'Pretty Woman' and her starring role alongside actor Richard Gere. From there her career took off and her charming smile made her 'America's Sweetheart'. He played several leading roles in romantic comedies but he has always tried to combine it with more serious roles such as those he played in 'Stay by me' or 'Erin Brockovich'.

programme.title: Killers
programme.desc: Spencer is a top secret government agent with a license to kill who decides to quit his job when he finds and marries the woman of his dreams. But happiness is short-lived, since they have put a price on his head. He doesn't know who is after him, but he knows that there are several murderers and that it could be anyone. His neighbors, his friends, former colleagues, his current co-workers... Spencer will team up with his wife to find out who the mysterious characters are who want him dead before the bullies finish them off... and their marriage!

programme.title: run like a girl
programme.desc: The true story of Michelle Payne, the first female jockey to win the Melbourne Cup. An inspiring story of effort, family, friendship and courage in the face of the impossible.

programme.title: Better... impossible
programme.desc: Melvin Udall is a novelist with obsessive-compulsive disorder that, among other things, causes him to walk down the street without stepping on sidewalk lines or to use new cutlery every time he eats. But Melvin is also proud of his ability to offend and irritate others, especially his neighbor Simon Nye, a homosexual artist whom the writer always attacks with his viperous tongue. Melvin has breakfast every day in a cafeteria and there is only one waitress who can put up with him, Carol, a single mother struggling to raise her asthmatic son. The fate of these characters will be intertwined because of a dog and a trip.

programme.title: Escape from Alcatraz
programme.desc: Frank Morris, a prisoner specialized in escapes with a very high intelligence quotient, is imprisoned in Alcatraz prison. In his head he keeps preparing an escape plan that will not be risk-free.

programme.title: Hulk
programme.desc: Bruce Banner is a renowned scientist, with a murky family past, who suffers with his team a serious laboratory accident in which everyone is exposed to intense gamma radiation. When he discovers that he is the only one who has survived, he is confused and begins to investigate. But Bruce has developed a terrible ability after the accident that could hinder the investigation; when he gets angry he turns into a giant green monster with irrational and destructive behavior. To create the Hulk character using digital technology, the company Light & Magic made the largest technical deployment in its history. It was necessary to work together with one hundred and eighty ILM technicians and work on the character for more than a year and a half. Even so, there are viewers who have compared the technical quality of the Hulk to that of Shrek. In this film, Hulk reaches the largest size he had reached to date, nine meters tall. Ang Lee used the split-screen technique to cinematically imitate the panels of a comic book page. To do this, he had to shoot the same scene several times, which somewhat exhausted actor Eric Bana, who plays Brece Banner. Much of the microbiology work seen on screen is real, done by Ang Lee's wife.

programme.title: Speed: Maximum power
programme.desc: Jack Traven is a young and intrepid Los Angeles SWAT police officer, who to date has succeeded in each of his missions. But this time the danger seems greater and less manageable. He has been locked in a bus with several passengers and a terrorist threatens to blow it up if he is not given three million dollars. If the bus exceeds eighty kilometers per hour or brakes, it will also explode. Just like if any of the passengers decide to get out of the vehicle. Jack is then forced to devise all kinds of strategies to save his life and that of all the civilians who accompany him in this race against time. Actress Sandra Bullock had to learn to drive a bus to play her role in the film. He passed the exam on the first try. According to Graham Yost, Joss Whedon wrote most of the dialogue, he is just not credited as a co-writer. Joss Whedon is the creator of the series 'Buffy the Vampire Slayer' and the director of films such as 'The Avengers' and 'The Cabin in the Woods'. Keanu Reeves initially turned down the role of Jack Traven, thinking the film would be too similar to Die Hard. He only accepted the role after Joss Whedon redesigned the script. The actor did ninety percent of the stunts that corresponded to his character.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Alan Parrish is a boy who accidentally finds a board game called Jumanji and convinces his friend Sarah to try it, but very strange events begin to occur and the game will catch them and change their lives. By throwing the dice, Alan is transported to a parallel world, where he will not be able to leave until the game ends, but circumstances cause Sarah to leave and Alan is trapped for 26 years in that other world until two new children find the game and start playing.

programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the jungle
programme.desc: In 1996, a teenager disappears after opening a strange board game. Twenty years later, the sporty Fridge, the pretty Bethany, the geeky Spencer and the clever Martha are punished to clean a classroom at their high school, where they discover an old video game.

programme.title: Jumanji: next level
programme.desc: The lives of Spencer, Martha, Bethany and Fridge have gone their separate ways. The two girls and the sporty Fridge are eager to meet again for Christmas, but Spencer is not so sure.

programme.title: Shark, revenge
programme.desc: Years pass and Ellen Brody continues to live in Amyty. Her sons, Sean and Micahel, no longer work at Sea World and her husband passed away some time ago due to cardiac arrest. Currently, Sean is the city's police officer. On Christmas night, he receives the order to go to the beach to unscrew a log from a buoy. In the process he is eaten by a great white shark. Convinced that the sharks have some kind of vendetta against her family, Ellen travels with Michael, his wife and daughter to a house they have in the Bahamas. What Ellen and her family don't know is that the threat has followed them there. The film's main tagline, 'This time it's personal', was parodied in 'Back to the Future II'. In the film you can see a poster for the fictional 'Jaws 19', directed by Max Spielberg and whose slogan is 'This time it's very personal.' This phrase has ended up becoming a cliché in movies with many sequels. Actor Michael Caine could not attend the Oscars and collect his award for 'Hannah and Her Sisters', because he was filming this film at that time. The water in the tank in which the film's climax was shot was filled with blue dye, so Micahel Caine and Lorraine Gary ended up with their hair completely dyed this color. Lorraine Gary was nominated for Best Actress at the United States Academy Awards for Science Fiction, Fantasy and Horror.

programme.title: The seventh son
programme.desc: Centuries ago, Master Gregory captured the evil and powerful witch Malkin. But the witch managed to escape and prepares her revenge. Meanwhile, Master Gregory sets out to teach his young apprentice Tom Ward to fight black magic in record time.

programme.title: The source of life
programme.desc: An odyssey about a man's fight to save the woman he loves in three time spaces: the 21st century, the conquest of America, and the future.

programme.title: Haute couture
programme.desc: Esther, first seamstress at the House of Dior, works on her latest Haute Couture collection, before retiring. Jade, a 20-year-old girl, steals her purse on the subway. Days later, repentant, she decides to go and return it. Esther decides to offer him a chance.

programme.title: McFarland
programme.desc: Based on a true story, the film tells the story of Jim White, a small-town California track coach who turns a small team of athletes into champions.

programme.title: Criminal
programme.desc: Dr. Franks is a prestigious neurosurgeon who is going to carry out a unique and very dangerous operation: implant the memories, secrets and abilities of CIA agent Bill Pope who has just died in the mind of another person. This is a cutting-edge method that is presented as the only way the agency has to recover confidential information of vital importance from Pope's memory that compromises the national security of the United States. The problem is that the only candidate to become the vessel of the deceased's mind is Jericho Stewart, a dangerous and unpredictable convict who is on death row awaiting execution and who has a brain abnormality that makes him perfect for the mission. However, no one can assure that the result is the most effective way to stop a terrible conspiracy that is hanging over the country.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Due to radioactive mutations that man has been producing over the years for decades, the sea monster Godzilla appears from the depths of the sea to try to stop a series of monsters, animated by man's scientific arrogance, that threaten to destroy humanity.

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Baby is a young man passionate about music and a talented getaway driver, taking criminals from one point to another to the rhythm of his personal soundtrack. It plots your escape route based on the songs coming out of your iPod and converts them into perfectly synchronized movements. Baby works for Doc, a big-shot crime boss who's on a roll robbing banks in broad daylight thanks to Baby's driving skills. In the same criminal gang there are other professionals such as Buddy, a former stockbroker, Darling, Buddy's wild and scandalous young accomplice, and Bats, an impulsive gunman whose suspicions about Baby begin to cause problems in the operation. When Baby meets the girl of his dreams, a sweet waitress named Débora, he sees an opportunity to abandon his life of crime and make a clean getaway, but decides to complete one last mission before retiring. However, Doc is not going to make it easy for him, so the young driver will have to fight for his love and his freedom.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Texas. Two years before the American Civil War breaks out. King Schultz is a German bounty hunter who is tracking murderers to collect for their heads, and he promises the black slave Django to set him free on the condition that he helps him catch them. Django accepts, since his greatest wish is to go rescue his wife Broomhilda, a slave who is on the plantation of landowner Calvin Candie. This film, written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, is a western film with references to the spaghetti western genre; genre through which I wanted to portray a story about slavery like this one. Tarantino is a renowned American director, producer and screenwriter whose films are characterized by addressing non-linear stories, violence, Grindhouse influences, kung fu and spaghetti westerns. Starring Jamie Foxx ('Bait', 'Collateral'), Christoph Waltz ('Inglourious Basterds', 'Dorian'), Leonardo DiCaprio ('Titanic', 'The Great Gatsby') and Samuel L. Jackson ('S.W.A.T.', 'Star Wars'); The film is a mix of good dialogue, rhythm, irony, and an impeccable soundtrack that allows it to capture the viewer's attention at all times.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2: El poder de Electro
programme.desc: Peter Parker leads a very busy life: he has to save the city from bad guys and also continue with his university life to take care of Gwen, although from a distance. Things get complicated when the villain Electro appears with a thirst for revenge. However, it won't be the only thing Peter has to face, as the return of an old friend, Harry Osborn, brings new clues about his past.

programme.title: The force of nature
programme.desc: A gang of thieves plans to rob a building, taking advantage of the arrival of a storm, but the strategy fails when the police want to evacuate the residents from their homes due to the arrival of a category 5 hurricane.

programme.title: Operation: Hurricane
programme.desc: A gang of thieves attempts to carry out an ambitious robbery of the United States Treasury to obtain a loot of 600 million dollars. Meanwhile, a Category 5 hurricane is approaching.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.: Harrelson's Men
programme.desc: Jim Street, former member of the S.W.A.T, was expelled from the team along with his partner Brian Gamble, due to a controversial decision he made in a robbery with hostages case. For Street, his work is his life and he is looking for the opportunity to wear the uniform again. That opportunity comes when Dan "Hondo" Harrelson, the team's commander, must recruit and train five high-level police officers for a new special weapons and tactics team. After a few hard weeks of training, the team goes into action: a drug lord offers a large sum of money to whoever frees him from police control. The S.W.A.T. team He must guard the enemy while being chased by a band of mercenaries. Film version of the famous 70's television series "Harrelson's Men".

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Natalie Cook, Dylan Sanders and Alex Munday are three special agents with overwhelming fighting and combat capabilities. But although each one is very different from the others, they will all be hired by a man named Charlie to carry out a special and very dangerous mission: find Eric Knox, a computer genius kidnapped because of his latest invention: an incredibly precise voice scanner. Through their investigations, Natalie, Dylan and Alex will discover clues that will lead them across the entire world, exuding charm and femininity to achieve their goals and destroying anyone who gets in their way. Drew Barrymore was a huge fan of the "Harry Potter" phenomenon, going so far as to read small parts of the different books to the members of the recording crew and the other actors. At the beginning of the film, when she is seen with glasses and black hair before being hired, she is also reading a Harry Potter book.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels: The Edge
programme.desc: Second part of Charlie's Angels. Dylan, Natalie and Alex are sent by their boss on a new mission: locate a group of rings that have been stolen from the Department of Justice. This device allows its owner to know the list of people who are in the FBI's Witness Protection Program. When the first witnesses begin to appear dead, the Angels will have to use all their ingenuity to solve the case. An exceptional cameo can be seen in this film: one of the original Angels, Jaclyn Smith.

programme.title: Conan the destroyer
programme.desc: Queen Taramis entrusts Conan with a very dangerous mission: to accompany Princess Jehnna on a long journey for which she was born predestined. Their objective is to recover a jewel that is in the possession of a powerful sorcerer. If he succeeds, the queen promises that she will help him recover Valeria, his great love. But the monarch's intentions are very different since with the jewel she wants to bring an ancient god back to life.

programme.title: Talking Business
programme.desc: Is the space economy the next gold rush? Elon Musk's SpaceX has sparked the public's imagination after its recent stock market debut, but what will all the money being thrown into the space industry actually achieve? The founder of leading investment firm Space Capital, Chad Anderson, explains how what happens in orbit is increasingly important to the economy down on Earth. Ben Thompson also hears from the head of the UN's Office for Outer Space Affairs, Aarti Holla-Maini, about how space law is keeping up with an industry that is moving at breakneck speed. Also on the programme, the billionaire founder of New Zealand-based Rocket Lab, Sir Peter Beck, shines a light on what the private sector can achieve in space and whether SpaceX are friends or rivals.

programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: The death of Cambridge academic Jason Arday has prompted intense debate about media conduct, following weeks of reporting on allegations of plagiarism and questions about aspects of his life story. Critics have accused journalists of contributing to an atmosphere of relentless scrutiny, while others argue that legitimate public interest questions were being pursued. Nick Clark, a childhood friend of Jason Arday, reflects on his experience of speaking to reporters. Charles Moore, columnist at The Telegraph and The Spectator, freelance journalist Seun Matiluko, Times columnist Sarah Ditum and columnist at the Financial Times Stephen Bush consider questions of proportionality, public interest and journalistic responsibility.

programme.title: Dari Nada Turun Ke Hati
programme.desc: Prisa, seorang mahasiswi baru jurusan musik, sedang berusaha mencari partitur lagu yang akan dimainkannya saat Ujian Akhir Semester. Dia pun berangkat ke sebuah perpustakaan musik dan bertemu Edwin.

programme.title: The Power Of Emak-Emak
programme.desc: Ibu Elis mengkhawatirkan Ira, anaknya yang pacaran dengan Andra. Ira tidak menyadari Andra itu playboy. Ibu Elis tidak setuju Ira melanjutkan hubungannya dengan Andra karena Andra sudah dua kali menabrak Ibu Elis.

programme.title: 7 Hari Kemudian
programme.desc: Mike, cowok playboy sekolah terkenal suka mempermainkan cewek. Fika mantan pacar Mike meninggal dunia karena bunuh diri. Amanda dan teman-temannya berencana membuat jera Mike. Mereka mengatur strategi untuk menjebak Mike.

programme.title: From The Fish Man
programme.desc: Seorang gadis yang kehilangan ayahnya karena ditarik ke dalam air oleh manusia ikan. Ternyata gadis itu terpesona oleh ketampanan si manusia ikan.Maukah sang gadis mengorbankan kehidupannya selama ini demi orang yang dia sayangi?

programme.title: Cincin Wali
programme.desc: Pemuda dari kota datang ke desa, dan melihat gadis yang pernah ditemuinya dalam mimpi. Dia memutuskan untuk tinggal di pesantren yang sama dengan gadis tersebut. Namun, untuk mendapatkan gadis itu dia harus memperoleh cincin wali

programme.title: Putri Salju Van Betawi
programme.desc: Puteri, seorang gadis yang dibuang dan akan dibunuh oleh Ibu tirinya. Dia akhirnya dibesarkan oleh seorang jawara betawi yang melatihnya menjadi seorang gadis pesilat handal yang akan menghadapi sang Ibu tiri dan pasukannya

programme.title: Radio Kabar Buruk
programme.desc: Kisah seorang wartawan yang sering membuat marah atasannya karena lambat bekerja dan selalu ketinggalan berita. Setelah menemukan radio antik di Toko Kr. Amat, dia selalu mengetahui semua peristiwa-peristiwa penting

programme.title: Kesengsem Tukang Sedot WC
programme.desc: Dika, seorang tukang sedot WC yang tampan, yang terlibat masalah dengan atasan barunya, anak perempuan pemilik perusahaan yang ditugaskan untuk menyelidiki dugaan penyelewengan dana perusahaan.

programme.title: Selengket Dodol Cinta
programme.desc: Patah hati menyebabkan Dudi dipecat dari pabrik dodol. Sementara itu datanglah Reyna, perempuan cantik jelita yang justru bikin keadaan Dudi semakin semrawut. Apa yang terjadi di antara mereka?

programme.title: Ketukan Yang Mengancam
programme.desc: Aris, Novi dan Danu adalah sahabat dekat sejak SMP. Setelah tanpa sengaja menguping pembicaraan tentang meja kayu tua misterius di gudang sekolah yang bisa memanggil arwah, mereka berniat membuktikannya.

programme.title: Jodoh Di Ujung Jari
programme.desc: Rio, cowok tampan playboy kampus, banyak cewek-cewek terpikat oleh Rio. Rio punya empat pacar dan harus bisa mengatur waktu dengan keempat pacarnya. Apakah akan berjalan dengan mulus?

programme.title: Putri Keong Mas
programme.desc: Puteri diserahkan kepada seorang dukun oleh ibu tirinya yang sangat kejam. Sejak saat itu, puteri hidup sebagai keong emas, dan hanya bisa kembali sebagai manusia jika ada seorang pemuda yang jatuh cinta kepadanya.

programme.title: Sepatu Roda Gila
programme.desc: Mike dan Thomas sama-sama ahli bermain sepatu roda. Sayangnya. geng mereka bermusuhan. Masalah semakin rumit saat Mike ditemukan tewas. Thomas menjadi tersangka utama atas pembunuhan itu. Apakah Thomas sungguh pembunuhnya?

programme.title: Perjalanan Terlarang
programme.desc: Mala dan temannya merencanakan untuk berkemah di hutan belantara, tetapi Mala dilarang orang tuanya dan mereka tetap nekat. Sejak itu mereka terjebak di hutan yang jauh dari keramaian.

programme.title: PDKT Berbahaya
programme.desc: Untuk mendekati Alin, Egi memaksa teman-temannya, Sony dan Amanda, untuk berlibur ke kampung halaman Alin. Dalam perjalanan menuju kesana mereka memutuskan untuk melewati jalan terlarang, dan mengalami banyak kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Petaka Topi Pemikat
programme.desc: Annisa kehilangan nenek yang merawatnya sejak kecil, ia difitnah para tetangga yang menuduhnya menjual rujak beracun. Kehidupan Annisa berubah saat mendapat topi pancar pesona dari toko KR. Amat. Setelah itu keanehan pun terjadi.

programme.title: Kabayan Mencari Cinta
programme.desc: Sosok legendaris tanah Sunda, Kabayan, kembali hadir. Kali ini, dia bertekad untuk melengkapi kehidupan asmaranya: ia mencari cinta!

programme.title: Saat Teduh Bersama Gereja Mawar Sharon
Descendant Of The Sun
programme.desc: Seorang bayi matahari ajaib dikirim ke bumi oleh seorang dewa dan dibesarkan oleh seorang tukang kayu tua. Ia memiliki kemampuan bela diri nan luar biasa, yang akan lenyap akibat 'kripton hijau' saat gerhana matahari.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian adalah seorang selir Kaisar Tang yang berusia 14 tahun nan cantik dan berbakat. Ia menjadi biarawati usai sang kaisar meninggal, tapi ia memiliki dua putra dengan Kaisar Tang Gao Zong.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: Seorang guru bela diri yang baru saja dipenjara bekerja sama dengan seorang wanita yang dizalimi untuk mengalahkan saudara laki-laki pria tersebut, seorang baron batu bara yang memerintah sebuah kota kecil dengan tangan besi.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: Yen Chun menyutradarai dan membintangi film nan menyentuh yang berkisah tentang Chen, seorang gadis kecil yang dikirim oleh orangtuanya ke sebuah peternakan milik kerabat di suatu musim panas yang tak terlupakan.

programme.title: Tales Of Larceny
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang menulis dan menyutradarai Tales of Larceny, kisah tentang tipu muslihat dan permainan licik di era panglima perang Tiongkok yang korup, dibintangi aktor-aktor karakter terbaik dari Shaw Brothers.

programme.title: Between Tears And Smiles
programme.desc: Kwan Shan harus menyelamatkan wanita yang ia cintai, sebelum wanita itu dipersembahkan sebagai hadiah untuk seorang Jenderal!

programme.title: No doubt Charn

Dead End

programme.title: Owls & Mice
programme.desc: Meral (8) baru saja pindah ke sebuah kota baru. Ia berusaha mendapatkan teman di sekolah barunya sebelum perkemahan musim gugur sekolah dimulai, tetapi ternyata hal itu lebih sulit dari yang dibayangkannya. Di rumah, ia berteman dengan seekor tikus kecil yang tinggal di kamar barunya, yang ia beri nama Peepeep. Baru setelah mereka bersama-sama pergi ke alam liar untuk mencari muntahan burung hantu yang berisi tulang-belulang Peepeep, Meral akhirnya memahami arti sebenarnya dari persahabatan. OWLS & MICE adalah sekuel dari FROGS & TOADS yang sukses dan memenangkan berbagai penghargaan, dari penulis dan sutradara yang sama, Simone van Dusseldorp.

Barnaby and Nelson visit Felicity's mother Valerie and fiance Brogan and they reveal that Felicity was going to confront ufologist Carter Faulkner about an illegal campsite - as they dig deeper, Barnaby and Nelson unearth suspicions, betrayals, and long-buried secrets of a terrestrial nature in their search for the truth.

programme.title: Vera

Vera is forced to make headway with the only clues they have; a mourning ring worn around the young man's neck, needle marks on the body, and a drugs wrap with a distinctive stamp - 'Dark Angel'. programme.title: Twelve Monkeys
programme.desc: Di dunia masa depan yang hancur karena penyakit, seorang narapidana dikirim kembali ke masa lalu untuk mengumpulkan informasi tentang virus buatan manusia yang memusnahkan sebagian besar populasi manusia di planet ini.

programme.title: The Goblin
programme.desc: Doo Hyeon yang dikenal dengan nama "Goblin" masuk penjara karena jatuh cinta pada Yeong Min yang membunuh bosnya. Setelah 10 tahun, Doo Hyeon dibebaskan dan telah menjalani kehidupan normal. Namun, dia harus menerima kenyataan bahwa Yeong Min telah memanfaatkan namanya "Goblin". Yeong Min bahkan menculik putrinya untuk tutup mulut. Doo Hyeon marah, melakukan balas dendam dan mengumumkan kembalinya "Goblin" yang asli.

programme.title: Dragon Inn: Night Of Salvation
programme.desc: Dragon Inn: Night of Salvation melanjutkan kisah organisasi rahasia Dragon Inn yang menjalankan misinya sendiri untuk menghukum para pelaku kejahatan yang lolos dari hukum. Kali ini mereka menerima kasus hilangnya seorang gadis remaja yang tidak memiliki alasan untuk melarikan diri dari rumah. Dalam proses penyelidikan, mereka menemukan keterkaitan antara kasus tersebut dengan sebuah sekte keagamaan yang beroperasi secara mencurigakan. Ketika identitas dan lokasi Dragon Inn terbongkar akibat sebuah kesalahan, para anggota organisasi harus menghadapi ancaman yang semakin besar. Di tengah pertarungan melawan kelompok berbahaya tersebut, mereka berusaha menyelamatkan korban sekaligus mengungkap kebenaran di balik jaringan kejahatan yang tersembunyi. Film ini menghadirkan perpaduan aksi, misteri, dan ketegangan yang lebih intens dibanding pendahulunya.

programme.title: Dragon Inn: The City Of Sadness
programme.desc: Dragon Inn: The City of Sadness mengisahkan sebuah organisasi vigilante yang beroperasi secara rahasia di balik sebuah restoran bernama Dragon Inn. Kelompok ini menjalankan misinya sendiri untuk menghukum para pelaku kejahatan yang tidak tersentuh hukum. Setiap anggota memiliki masa lalu kelam dan alasan pribadi yang mendorong mereka bergabung. Situasi berubah ketika putra seorang pengusaha terkenal ditemukan tewas dan salah satu anggota Dragon Inn diduga terlibat dalam kasus tersebut. Di tengah penyelidikan, berbagai rahasia, pengkhianatan, dan konflik berdarah mulai terungkap. Para anggota harus berjuang menghadapi musuh dari luar sekaligus mempertahankan kepercayaan satu sama lain dalam dunia yang dipenuhi korupsi dan balas dendam.

programme.title: Tuning – it doesn’t get any lower than that!
programme.desc: The BSG Racing crew is very familiar with spectacular conversions. Dirk Hattenhauer and his boys have already refined quite a few cars. Now they have taken on a very special project. You want to really spruce up an old Opel Kadett C Coupé. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: Top speed presenter Martin Utberg was invited by Dominic Müller, owner of the Hotel Ritter in Durbach, which is well known among vintage car enthusiasts, to cook with him. Of course, the main topic always revolves around classic cars. But Dominic still has more surprises up his sleeve. (Station info).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The 60s and 70s – the golden years for Opel. The traditional brand is at its best. Ascona, Manta, Rekord and GT: Opel is more than just a car, Opel is an attitude to life. Opel is colorful, fashionable, exciting - and builds one classic after another. Today they are all cult. Car History shows the heyday of Opel. (Station info).

programme.title: Australian Drag Racing Championship 2024
programme.desc: The "Australian Drag Racing Championship" is a regional motorsport series for top petrol dragsters that reach speeds of around 500 km/h in under 5 seconds (channel information).

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing professionals are carried out of the curve, then we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of sophisticated tin bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed. (Station info).

programme.title: Dumbest Stuff on Wheels
programme.desc: Bizarre mishaps, weird crashes and unbelievable nonsense on four wheels, fabricated in everyday life and immortalized on camera. Great workout for your laughing muscles! (Station info).

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: It was the pursuit of the upper class, or rather the stars that were emblazoned on the Mercedes hoods. In 1964, Opel presented the KAD series to the world: Captain, Admiral and Diplomat. The line is American, the technology is solidly German. The Diplomat in particular with the big V8 engine instills fear in the competition, such as Mercedes and BMW. Classic Ride presents the entire series including an ultra rare and extra elegant Diplomat Coupé. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: In 2019, the Upper Bavarian Master Classic of the Munich-Upper Bavaria Motor Vehicle Guild will take place for the sixth time. As in previous years, the organizers have once again chosen a new venue this year. The rally, which is designed with a focus on togetherness, is taking place this year in and around the picturesque Altmühltal. (Station info).

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: The Stunt Heroes are on tour! On an industrial site in Thuringia they find the ideal place to jump with their stunt car across a moving truck trailer. Problem: the trailer is brand new and must under no circumstances be broken... A special challenge for stunt coordinator Domi and his team! (Station info).

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: Slovenia – There are many motorcycle destinations in Europe, but hardly anyone thinks of Slovenia. On our tour of Slovenia we discovered that a visit on two wheels is definitely worth it. Various landscapes with high mountain ranges, low mountain ranges and hilly areas, as well as the Slovenian Riviera, have their charm. On our tours we visit Lake Bled, Ljubljana, eastern Slovenia, the Postojna Caves and of course Piran, the Slovenian Riviera. The highlights and spectacular drone flights can be seen in the film. (Station info).

programme.title: On Tour
programme.desc: On tour today at the Kings of Xtreme in Leipzig. And Kings of Xtreme definitely means one thing: extreme! Namely freestyle motocross, not just on regular motocross bikes but also on BMX bikes, quads and a snowmobile. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: Glowing asphalt, roaring engines, and pure sunshine: these are the ingredients for the Mythos Sports Car event, which was held for the first time in 2001. A colorful mix of classic Gran Tourismos, thoroughbred racing cars, rally legends, exotics and sports cars is permitted, regardless of brand and year of manufacture. Also: Classic is reminiscent of the time when Capri and Manta came with vinyl roofs. (Station info).

programme.title: Green wave
programme.desc: More and more traffic, tight delivery schedules and a constant flood of information – professional drivers don't have it easy. At the same time, modern trucks offer new digital features that make driving safer and more efficient. MOTORVISION visits the traditional Swedish manufacturer Volvo Trucks, watches the development of new automation systems and goes on a journey with the digital giants. (Station info).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.desc: The Fiat 500X, SUV offshoot of the popular 500, is built in Melfi in southern Italy. The factory is one of the most modern in Europe. The FCA Group has invested almost one billion euros in the expansion. Up to 1,600 vehicles roll off the production line here every day. Made in Italy – FIAT provides insight into the production of the oldest and largest Italian automobile manufacturer. (Station info).

programme.title: Four-wheel drive adventure
programme.desc: A special interest magazine about off-road and all-wheel drive vehicles. The focus is on off-road veterans and cars with four-wheel drive. (Station info).

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Today's episode of Perfect Ride is full of racing fever! In Saalbach Hinterglemm, the celebrities are really stepping up their game at the Snow Mobile. The spectacular snowmobile race is the Formula 1 of winter and offers pure snow, fun and action! And: Formula 1 driver Sebastian Vettel takes on a very special role in RNB star Melanie Fiona's music video. The two of them do a few hot laps on the asphalt together. (Station info).

programme.title: 4x4 – Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: Fire, earth, water, air – without the four elements life would be unimaginable. However, without four driven wheels, highland crossings or desert expeditions in a car would be unthinkable. All-wheel drive ensures safety and traction even in inhospitable areas. 4x4 shows four all-wheel drive vehicles on their arduous journey through the four elements. Among other things, the Porsche Macan Turbo in the Moroccan desert and a bizarre VW swimming car that crosses the Danube. (Station info).

programme.title: Tuning – it doesn’t get any lower than that!
programme.desc: The 82nd International Motor Show in Geneva is the first important vehicle trade fair in the new year. 260 exhibitors present 850 exhibition vehicles on an area of ​​110,000 m2. Around 180 world and European premieres will be shown. Of course, the top-class refiners should not be missing. Only the crème de la crème of fine tuning gathers here. Also: The SL 63 AMG. The now sixth generation of the SL is more powerful than ever before. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: Top Speed ​​in Focus is all about classic vehicles – seen through the eyes of ambitious amateur photographers. A total of nine candidates compete against each other in three preliminary rounds. In each preliminary round, three participants competed in two photo tasks for points and a place in the grand finale. Today it will be decided who will convince with the best sense of image composition, technology and storytelling. In the final, Jens, Chiara and Ralf compete against each other. This episode is filmed at the Top Mountain Motorcycle Museum in Hochgurgl. The works will again be assessed by Daniel Reinhard, internationally renowned motorsport photographer. Profes (station info).

programme.title: Super Cars
programme.desc: The Geneva International Motor Show is traditionally the first European car show of the year and the Geneva Motor Show is now one of the most important car shows in the world. Like no other trade fair, the automobile show at Lac Léman also stands for a variety of studies, exotic cars, super sports cars and small series models. Almost all manufacturers are showing their latest electric, fuel cell or hybrid cars in Geneva. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic

programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: Italy is the land of automotive dreams and home to the most beautiful classic car event in the world: the Mille Miglia. Every year the entire nation is enchanted by the myth of historic automobiles. Only vehicles built between 1924 and 1957 that were either present at the historic Mille or would at least have been eligible to take part are eligible to take part. (Station info).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: It is the second largest automobile manufacturer in the world, Volkswagen AG. But at the beginning of the 1970s, VW was in crisis. VW has no answer to the oil price shock and no successor to the Beetle. Only with the new generation Passat and Golf cars will the factory get back on the fast track. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: In 1990, the fastest one-make cup in the world started its first season: the Porsche Carrera Cup. The 911 Carrera 2 Cup Coupé with a six-cylinder boxer engine with 265 hp and 35 hot-blooded and ambitious racing drivers - the hottest racing cocktail in the world was ready. (Station info).

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Sebastian Vettel is the new hero of motorsport. At just 23 years old, he won his first world championship title in 2010, making him the youngest Formula 1 champion of all time. Motorheads shows an exciting documentary about the rise, the fans, the life and the dreams of the Heppenheimer. (Station info).

programme.title: Top speed – on the go
programme.desc: In On the Road, presenter Martin Utberg takes a guest who has a special affinity for motorsport, classic automobiles or super sports cars on a ride in his car. The conversations are unedited, personal and open - far from pre-written questions. In 24 minutes it's about careers, passions, relationships and everything you can't find about the guest on Wikipedia. (Station info).

programme.title: On Tour
programme.desc: On tour today at the Kings of Xtreme in Leipzig. And Kings of Xtreme definitely means one thing: extreme! Namely freestyle motocross, not just on regular motocross bikes but also on BMX bikes, quads and a snowmobile. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: Glowing asphalt, roaring engines, and pure sunshine: these are the ingredients for the Mythos Sports Car event, which was held for the first time in 2001. A colorful mix of classic Gran Tourismos, thoroughbred racing cars, rally legends, exotics and sports cars is permitted, regardless of brand and year of manufacture. Also: Classic is reminiscent of the time when Capri and Manta came with vinyl roofs. (Station info).

programme.title: Green wave
programme.desc: More and more traffic, tight delivery schedules and a constant flood of information – professional drivers don't have it easy. At the same time, modern trucks offer new digital features that make driving safer and more efficient. MOTORVISION visits the traditional Swedish manufacturer Volvo Trucks, watches the development of new automation systems and goes on a journey with the digital giants. (Station info).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.desc: The Fiat 500X, SUV offshoot of the popular 500, is built in Melfi in southern Italy. The factory is one of the most modern in Europe. The FCA Group has invested almost one billion euros in the expansion. Up to 1,600 vehicles roll off the production line here every day. Made in Italy – FIAT provides insight into the production of the oldest and largest Italian automobile manufacturer. (Station info).

programme.title: Four-wheel drive adventure
programme.desc: A special interest magazine about off-road and all-wheel drive vehicles. The focus is on off-road veterans and cars with four-wheel drive. (Station info).

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Today's episode of Perfect Ride is full of racing fever! In Saalbach Hinterglemm, the celebrities are really stepping up their game at the Snow Mobile. The spectacular snowmobile race is the Formula 1 of winter and offers pure snow, fun and action! And: Formula 1 driver Sebastian Vettel takes on a very special role in RNB star Melanie Fiona's music video. The two of them do a few hot laps on the asphalt together. (Station info).

programme.title: 4x4 – Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: Fire, earth, water, air – without the four elements life would be unimaginable. However, without four driven wheels, highland crossings or desert expeditions in a car would be unthinkable. All-wheel drive ensures safety and traction even in inhospitable areas. 4x4 shows four all-wheel drive vehicles on their arduous journey through the four elements. Among other things, the Porsche Macan Turbo in the Moroccan desert and a bizarre VW swimming car that crosses the Danube. (Station info).

programme.title: Tuning – it doesn’t get any lower than that!
programme.desc: The 82nd International Motor Show in Geneva is the first important vehicle trade fair in the new year. 260 exhibitors present 850 exhibition vehicles on an area of ​​110,000 m2. Around 180 world and European premieres will be shown. Of course, the top-class refiners should not be missing. Only the crème de la crème of fine tuning gathers here. Also: The SL 63 AMG. The now sixth generation of the SL is more powerful than ever before. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: Top Speed ​​in Focus is all about classic vehicles – seen through the eyes of ambitious amateur photographers. A total of nine candidates compete against each other in three preliminary rounds. In each preliminary round, three participants competed in two photo tasks for points and a place in the grand finale. Today it will be decided who will convince with the best sense of image composition, technology and storytelling. In the final, Jens, Chiara and Ralf compete against each other. This episode is filmed at the Top Mountain Motorcycle Museum in Hochgurgl. The works will again be assessed by Daniel Reinhard, internationally renowned motorsport photographer. Profes (station info).

programme.title: Australian Drag Racing Championship 2024
programme.desc: The "Australian Drag Racing Championship" is a regional motorsport series for top petrol dragsters that reach speeds of around 500 km/h in under 5 seconds (channel information).

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing professionals are carried out of the curve, then we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of sophisticated tin bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed. (Station info).

programme.title: Dumbest Stuff on Wheels
programme.desc: Bizarre mishaps, weird crashes and unbelievable nonsense on four wheels, fabricated in everyday life and immortalized on camera. Great workout for your laughing muscles! (Station info).

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Lots of chrome, free-standing lamp pots, bulbous fenders, swelling shapes wherever you look – typical pre-war look. The Triumph 1800 was the British manufacturer's first new design after the Second World War. The four-seater with a mother-in-law seat, presented in 1947, established the long tradition of the British post-war roadster. The 1800 is not a tough corner robber, but rather a comfortable tourer for leisurely country trips. Also in the show: BMW 507 and Porsche 356 Cabrio. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: At the Classic Classic in Stuttgart, where founder Karl Ulrich Herrmann says goodbye after 20 successful years, top speed presenter Martin Utberg is looking for the answer to the question of whether classic cars have a future. (Station info).

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: The Stunt Heroes are always looking for action. In this episode they simulate a chase between a dump truck and a car. At the end the car crashes into a pile of gravel. Because it's his birthday today, stuntman Stefan had to drive the crash car! (Station info).

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.sub-title: Catalonia 2024, rush of curves in the Catalan mountains,
programme.desc: Motorcycling in Catalonia means driving fun in untouched wilderness, on lonely mountain roads, countless curves and breathtaking panoramas. On the way, medieval villages such as Peratallada, Besalu or Rupit enchant with their unique charm. This motorcycle travel film shows the highlights of our tours through the Spanish Pyrenees with fantastic drone footage and unique driving footage. (Station info).

programme.title: On Tour
programme.desc: Motorvision on Tour today in deepest Austria, at Lake Zenz. A particularly cool event takes place here: Snow & Ice Drifting and this is where our presenter will of course learn to drift today. And not with just anyone - he's looking for the coolest professional racing team in rallying. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: Karl Kerschbaumer is not only active as a farmer in the Carinthian mountains between Spittal an der Drau and Villach. In his garage there are not agricultural machines and tractors, but capricious beauties from the Alfa Romeo brand. Classic visited the Alfa collector. Also: With the ADAC Bavaria Historic, probably the most renowned classic car rally in southern Germany is entering the next round. (Station info).

programme.title: Green wave
programme.desc: Natural gas is on everyone’s lips. CNG cars used to be labeled as eco-friendly, but they are currently enjoying a new lease of life. The alternative fuel offers significant advantages over diesel or electric. Motorvision is conducting the practical test with the Audi A5 G-Tron sedan, the Fiat Panda CNG small car and the compact Seat Leon ST CNG. (Station info).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.desc: The Range Rover Velar – The vehicle is a milestone for the traditional British company Land Rover. It takes the mid-size SUV segment to a whole new level of luxury. MOTORVISION TV accompanies the creation of the Velar and shows English craftsmanship paired with modern mass production. (Station info).

programme.desc: Adventure Allrad, a special interest magazine about off-road and all-wheel drive vehicles. The focus is on off-road veterans and cars with four-wheel drive. (Station info).

programme.title: 4x4 – Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: Pick-ups are universal commercial vehicles that are primarily driven by commercial drivers in this country. In the USA, on the other hand, “trucks” are almost as widespread as SUVs. What makes flatbed trucks so attractive? 4x4 tests the German VW Amarok and compares it with a Japanese veteran: the Toyota Hilux. Off-road expert Kurt Sigl and Toyota expert Alexander Wolfarth test the two opponents off-road and on the road. (Station info).

programme.title: Tuning – it doesn’t get any lower than that!
programme.desc: The BSG Racing crew is very familiar with spectacular conversions. Dirk Hattenhauer and his boys have already refined quite a few cars. Now they have taken on a very special project. You want to really spruce up an old Opel Kadett C Coupé. But not just like that. The car is supposed to be the most spectacular custom car the European tuning scene has to offer. But before that happens, there is still a lot of work ahead of them. Today is the most important step in the renovation: the wedding. (Station info).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: It is the car of reason, it is not exciting, but it is the mega seller: the VW Golf, the most successful car in Europe, sold 30 million times. The Golf is mass compatible, classless and it dominates the compact car class. Because of its success, it has long been called the golf class. The models from the I series have long been cult, especially the legendary Golf Gti and the Golf convertible. Car History tells the story of the Golf generation and explains the secret of its success. (Station info).

programme.title: Super Cars
programme.sub-title: Unbridled power in the finest packaging
programme.desc: The facelift of the E-Class was worth around a billion euros to Mercedes! The E 63 AMG also benefits from this. The high-performance brand from Mercedes-Benz has made further improvements to the appearance, but above all to the technology. The performance of the S model with the 5.5-liter biturbo V8, for example, increases to 585 hp. But the most important change is certainly the 4Matic all-wheel drive, which is available for the first time in this AMG model. (Station info).

programme.desc: Crash or be crashed, that is the big question at the stock car race in Herzfelde! It doesn't take much to catapult your competitors out of the race. The legendary vehicles with the Spirit of Ecstasy on the radiator grille have been built in England since the beginning of the 20th century. Today it is mainly very wealthy people who make the decision to purchase a Rolls Royce. No two ordered models are the same. Because the Bespoke customization department leaves no wish for individualization unfulfilled and so each vehicle is an absolutely unique piece. Made in takes a look behind the scenes at the Rolls Royce factory in southern England. (Station info).
